This update comes straight from your feedback. We've focused on making the whole experience smoother and faster, so your feed flows better and feels more seamless every time you open the app. We also tracked down the bugs you reported and fixed them. On top of that, we polished the design throughout to keep your time in the Word clean and free of distractions.

Thank you for being part of this. Scroll the Bible is built for you, and every piece of feedback genuinely shapes where we take it next. Keep it coming, because we read all of it.

Happy reading.
results.description:
What if your phone could pull you closer to God instead of further away?

Scroll The Bible turns the same scrolling habit that drains your day into the one that fills it. Verse by verse. Just like your favorite social app. But this feed is the Word of God.

No clutter. No noise. No comparison traps. Just Scripture, beautifully designed, one verse at a time.


SCROLL THE BIBLE LIKE SOCIAL MEDIA

The main feed is a smooth, full-screen, vertical scroll through every book and chapter of the Bible. Swipe up. Swipe up again. Read the Word the way your brain is already wired to consume content.

Comment on verses. Share them with friends. Tap any verse to instantly unlock four powerful study tools:

Deep Study breaks down the meaning, context, and life application of the verse.

Original Language reveals the Greek, Hebrew, or Aramaic word behind the English translation.

Explain It Easier rewrites the verse in plain, modern language anyone can understand.

Related Verses shows you connected passages across all of Scripture.


THE DISCOVER PAGE

When you do not know where to start, start here. The Discover page is a feed of random Bible verses, each one already loaded with a full deep study. Just keep scrolling.

Every verse on the Discover page includes:

Historical Context. Understand the world the verse was written into.

Original Language. See the Greek, Hebrew, or Aramaic words and what they really meant.

Life In Biblical Times. Step into the culture, customs, and daily life of the people who first heard these words.

Did You Know. Surprising facts and hidden details most people never learn about Scripture.

Theological Significance. Why this verse matters in the bigger story of God.

Cross References. Other passages that connect to the same theme, story, or truth.

Apply It. Practical, real-life ways to live the verse out today.

Explore In Scripture. Related verses to take you deeper into what God is saying.


VERSE SEARCH

Search any single word or any single verse in the entire Bible. The results page lets you choose your study depth:

Basic Study gives you a clear, simple breakdown perfect for quick understanding.

Advanced Study unlocks the full theological, historical, and original language deep dive.

Switch between Basic and Advanced anytime with a single tap.


BUILT FOR THE WAY YOU ALREADY USE YOUR PHONE

This is the Bible app for the generation that grew up scrolling. Every feature is designed to make Scripture as easy to engage with as the apps you already open without thinking.

Replace doom scrolling with Scripture scrolling. Replace mindless feeds with the mind of Christ. Replace the algorithm with the Word.


WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING

Rated 4.9 stars by readers who say things like:

"I constantly feel awful because I spend my mornings and nights doomscrolling. Now I am scrolling the Bible. Ten out of ten."

"Scrolling through the Bible is such a novel idea and the app is so smooth and clean."

"An amazing app. Thanks to the creators for sharing the Word of God."


PERFECT FOR

Anyone trying to break a social media habit.

Daily Bible reading and quiet time.

Bible study groups and small groups.

New believers exploring Scripture for the first time.

Long time Christians who want to go deeper.

Anyone who has ever opened the Bible and not known where to start.


Scroll The Bible was built by someone who believes the Word of God deserves the same design quality, the same smooth experience, and the same pull on your attention as the apps you already cannot put down.

Download Scroll The Bible and turn your scroll into Scripture.
